BISC 1: This course is an introduction into the cellular structures and processes that take place in living organisms, and how life displays unity even in its diversity.
BISC 2: In BISC 2 (GN;3cr.), students will explore concepts, current issues, and the relationship between three core areas of biological sciences: Genetics, Ecology and Evolution.
BISC 4: BISC 4 Human Body: Form and Function (3) (GN) (BA) This course introduces students to the biological principles fundamental to understanding human life.
